source.probe: hmtx per case class over the script Latin

note:
Lucida Handwriting ships with Office (Word's DFonts) and Windows, not macOS
or Linux, so Chromium fell to the Helvetica-class sans: ~23% narrower per
body line and 1.15 pitch instead of its 1.3794. Against Liberation Sans
Italic (hmtx of both fonts over the script's Latin, 2026-09-24) its
lowercase runs +30.7%, capitals +8.2%, digits +21.3%, space and punctuation
+22.5%, so per-case faces carry the adjustment. Registered weight-normal
only: the font has a single cut and Word synthesizes bold without changing
advances.
